name: dola-themes
description: Animated themes for the Claude desktop app: 26 looks with light and dark modes, switched with /dola-<name>

speed.title: Animation speed
speed.description: How fast the backdrop moves: calm, normal or lively.

glass.title: Frosted glass
glass.description: Veil over the backdrop: clear (sharp but dimmed so text stays readable), off, light, strong, or default (the app blur).

startMode.title: Start mode
startMode.description: Light or dark, until you pick one with /dola-mode.
